description: Defines the PhysicalDataType hierarchy and associated classes for representing physical data types in Spark SQL Catalyst, including specific implementations for primitive, complex, and spatial types.

classes.name: PhysicalDataType
classes.description: Abstract base class for all physical data types, with internal type, ordering, and type tag.

classes.name: PhysicalPrimitiveType
classes.description: Marker trait for primitive physical data types.

classes.name: PhysicalNumericType
classes.description: Abstract class for numeric types, includes exact numeric handling.

classes.name: PhysicalFractionalType
classes.description: Abstract class for fractional numeric types, includes fractional and integral representations.

classes.name: PhysicalIntegralType
classes.description: Abstract class for integral numeric types.

classes.name: PhysicalBinaryType
classes.description: Implementation for binary data type, compares byte arrays.

classes.name: PhysicalBooleanType
classes.description: Implementation for boolean data type.

classes.name: PhysicalByteType
classes.description: Implementation for byte data type.

classes.name: PhysicalCalendarIntervalType
classes.description: Implementation for calendar interval type, ordering unsupported.

classes.name: PhysicalDecimalType
classes.description: Implementation for decimal type with precision and scale.

classes.name: PhysicalDoubleType
classes.description: Implementation for double-precision floating point type.

classes.name: PhysicalFloatType
classes.description: Implementation for single-precision floating point type.

classes.name: PhysicalIntegerType
classes.description: Implementation for integer type.

classes.name: PhysicalLongType
classes.description: Implementation for long integer type.

classes.name: PhysicalMapType
classes.description: Implementation for map data type, with custom ordering for comparison.

classes.name: PhysicalNullType
classes.description: Implementation for null type.

classes.name: PhysicalShortType
classes.description: Implementation for short integer type.

classes.name: PhysicalStringType
classes.description: Implementation for string type with collation support.

classes.name: PhysicalArrayType
classes.description: Implementation for array data type with element ordering.

classes.name: PhysicalStructType
classes.description: Implementation for struct data type with schema-based ordering.

classes.name: PhysicalVariantType
classes.description: Implementation for variant type, comparison not supported.

classes.name: UninitializedPhysicalType
classes.description: Placeholder for uninitialized physical type, comparison not supported.

classes.name: PhysicalGeographyType
classes.description: Implementation for geography spatial type.

classes.name: PhysicalGeometryType
classes.description: Implementation for geometry spatial type.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory method to create PhysicalDataType from DataType.

methods.name: ordering
methods.description: Returns the ordering for a given DataType.

methods.name: forSchema
methods.description: Creates an ordering for struct fields based on schema.
